teaser: Kesh closed the largest node in the Survey and carved out the one shelf Aster asked him to leave alone, so the arrival shelves are now one well-made question and twelve shelves have gone white under her hands. The sector's lights have been paid for by Aster's house for sixty-one years, and the first payer line under her name is written in a hand nobody in the building can read. Somewhere under the exception, the Survey has grown a peak it has no question for yet.

options.label: Chase the unreadable name
options.prompt: Continue the story: let Kesh go looking for the first line under the sector's payer column, and find who signed for the Earth-Library before Aster's house.

options.label: Read the two hundred seventeen
options.prompt: Continue the story: show Kesh reading the small bench's two hundred and seventeen unsorted books closely enough to see what question they have in common.

options.label: Return one year later
options.prompt: Let one year pass in the Earth-Library and show what the twelve whitened shelves have done to Aster, and what Kesh is doing about it.
